rules.statement: The Kandy District Court has jurisdiction over the case where the cause of action arises within its jurisdiction, even if the defendant resides and the lands are outside the court's limits.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, the jurisdiction of District Courts is laid down by section 9 of the Ordinance No. 2 of 1889 to be (1) over parties resident within its jurisdiction, (2) over land situated, in whole or in part, within its jurisdiction, (3) where the cause of action has arisen within its jurisdiction, or (4) where the contract sought to be enforced was made."
